usedFor: Templated makes images from templates, and “Create Render” produces a new image while “Merge Renders” combines several.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Render” in Templated
bestTemplate.why: A new order can produce a fresh image from your template.

watchOut: “New Template Created” is polling, so new templates are noticed on a schedule.
